🎵 Your Offline Music Companion

MusicTune helps you import, organize, and enjoy the music already on your device. Listen anywhere without an internet connection, subscriptions, or playback limits.

🌟 Key Features

🎧 Lossless & High-Quality Audio
Play your local music in supported formats, including MP3, MIDI, WAV, FLAC, AAC, and APE. Enjoy clear, high-quality playback and lossless audio support for compatible files.

📚 Smart Library Management
MusicTune automatically organizes your local music by artist, album, genre, and playlist, making it easier to find what you want to hear.

🎶 Playlists & Favorites
Save favorite songs and create personalized playlists for workouts, commutes, study sessions, or relaxing at home.

▶️ Background Playback
Keep your music playing while you use other apps. Control playback from the lock screen and notification panel without reopening the app.

🌙 Dark Mode
Enjoy a comfortable listening experience day or night with Dark Mode.

📴 Made for Offline Listening
Listen during flights, road trips, subway commutes, workouts, or anywhere with a weak or unavailable internet connection. Your music stays ready on your device.

🔒 Privacy First
Your music library stays on your device. MusicTune does not collect or share your personal data, and no cloud storage is required.

✨ Simple, Local, and Unlimited
Import compatible audio files, organize your library, and enjoy your music your way. No subscriptions, no limits, just your music.

Background Playback
MusicTune uses Android's media playback service so music can continue playing in the background and playback controls remain available in the notification panel.

Feature availability may vary by Android version and audio format.
